tion\": \"Run against one of the suite's attached project environments. Requires `suiteId`, and must be a member of that suite's `

hed environment runs against it automatically (the response's `environment` says which); a suite with several returns `400` with `

ronment\": {\"type\": \"boolean\", \"description\": \"When true, `environmentId` may be a project-scoped, non-archived environment

ironments/capabilities` (`ephemeralEnvironmentLaunch`) before sending: older servers reject the unknown field.\"}, \"namedHostId\"

ost attachments runs under the suite's own default host config: the run executes, but the result is attributed to the wrong host.\

sExcluded`, so the arm is labelled rather than merely empty. The run's MCP servers stay connected, so both arms connect the same s
ervers.\"}, \"refreshSnapshot\": {\"type\": \"boolean\", \"description\": \"**PERSISTS A SUITE MUTATION.** Re-derives and stores t

ns.\"}, \"runGroupId\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"description\": \"A LABEL that groups sibling run rows for display. It has NO quot

string\", \"maxLength\": 256, \"description\": \"Write-idempotency key. A repeat call with the same key (same actor and suite) ret
urns the EXISTING run instead of creating and billing a second one. The `Idempotency-Key` header carries the same value and WINS o
ver this field: it is the transport-level channel unattended clients control, whereas a body key could be shaped by model output.\
"}, \"sourceHash\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"pattern\": \"^[a-f0-9]{64}$\", \"description\": \"SHA-256 hex of the suite-file bytes

al under another's name and a caller-supplied timestamp could be backdated past the edit that invalidated the claim. Nothing persi
sts on the case: the next run of the same approximation needs a new approval.\", \"items\": {\"type\": \"object\", \"required\": [
